title: A new pinned artifact turns a content sync into a code merge request: kbgit.py fix rewrites .gitattributes, a code-lane path
goal: A sync whose only code-lane change is the pinned block of .gitattributes that kbgit.py fix regenerates (a new _artifacts.csv row) stays in the content lane and pushes to main; kblane's docstring claim that every path kbgit.py fix rewrites is content is true (test_gitattributes_fix_is_content in _tools/test_kblane.py asserts every path fix_texts writes is content); found by the SP-v5xagbyv review
